description: Don't Blame Me is mother at her most unhinged and I am OBSESSED 😭🔥 'I once was poison ivy but now I'm your daisy' is a top 5 lyric of all time and it's about Joe Alwyn and it's perfect. The way she goes full gospel pop about being so in love it's basically a drug?? iconic. The vocal run at the end is everything. A dark horse banger and I will die on this hill 💅✨
